entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I ordered a jersey a while ago and it's just been sitting here. I'm not sure what the policy is, the website was a little confusing for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's way too tight. I was hoping to maybe do an exchange, but I got lost trying to figure it out online. I just... I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm happy to help you with that. Getting the right fit is very important. I've pulled up your account, and I can see the order for the jersey was delivered about 79 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility for you.
79 days? Oh my. Is that too long? I was so worried I missed the window.

Not at all. I have good news. Our policy for standard items like this allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that timeframe, so we can absolutely get this processed for you.
Oh, what a relief! Thank you! So, what's the next step? I'd really love to just exchange it for a bigger size if possible.

An exchange is definitely possible. I can initiate the process right now. I will email you a prepaid return shipping label. All you'll need to do is package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately.
That's perfect! That sounds so much easier. Thank you so much, David. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that email. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
